self_assessment.weakest_area: lastSyncedAt is null for all 12 devs in local D1 state — card hides timestamp gracefully but the 'updated {relative}' affordance from the contract won't show in dev. Needs verification against production data, or a synced D1 snapshot, before declaring the time-ago line definitively works.
self_assessment.hardest_decision: Used a new dedicated endpoint instead of extending /api/social/curators. Two endpoints + one card-shape per kind avoids forcing every consumer to discriminate on a `kind` field, and keeps atproto-specific fields (labels, firstPublished) confined to the curator response.
